report.summary: Metrics support the claim that checkout's PlaceOrder path carries elevated error spans in the authorized window, but trace-level corroboration and root cause were not obtainable. In the hour ending 2026-10-19T14:34:10Z, checkout's oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder span carries a STATUS_CODE_ERROR increase of 13.22 vs 79.32 STATUS_CODE_UNSET, i.e. roughly a 14% error share of PlaceOrder spans, and the last 15 minutes of the window show 13.93 error vs 15.00 non-error PlaceOrder spans. This contrasts with a same-metric baseline earlier in the window: 12 of the 16 hours from 15:34:10 Oct 18 to 06:34:10 Oct 19 had zero PlaceOrder error increase, with only 1.02-2.03 in two of the remaining hours. Elevated hours resume from the hour ending 07:34:10Z and are intermittent (22.37, 8.14, 0, 23.39, 1.02, 12.20, 1.02, 13.22). The errors are not isolated to checkout: in the last hour identical error counts (13.22) appear at frontend-proxy ingress, frontend /api/checkout, frontend's PlaceOrder client call, checkout's PaymentService/Charge client call and payment's grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge server span, and checkout's client Charge calls show gRPC status code 2 = 13.22 versus code 0 = 79.32, while the same code-2 series was 0 in a baseline hour. That points to PaymentService/Charge as the deepest erroring operation; because no span parent references or error details could be retrieved, this remains a hypothesis and the mechanism behind gRPC status 2 is unknown.

claims.text: In the 24h view of checkout's oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder span, hourly error increases were 0 for the hours ending 15:34:10 Oct 18, 16:34:10, 19:34:10 through 06:34:10 Oct 19 (12 hours), and only 1.02 (hour ending 17:34:10) and 2.03 (18:34:10); non-error (STATUS_CODE_UNSET) values stayed in the ~66-105 per-hour range throughout.

From the hour ending 07:34:10Z onward, PlaceOrder error increases became nonzero and bursty: 22.37 (07:34:10), 8.14 (08:34:10), 0 (09:34:10), 23.39 (10:34:10), 1.02 (11:34:10), 12.20 (12:34:10), 1.02 (13:34:10) and 13.22 (14:34:10), against non-error values of 63-89.

Payment's grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge server span shows the same hourly error pattern as checkout PlaceOrder (e.g. 21.36 vs 22.37 in the hour ending 07:34:10, 23.39 in the hour ending 10:34:10, 13.22 in the hour ending 14:34:10), while its non-error values track the same ~62-105 per-hour shape.

In the hour ending 14:34:10Z, error spans with an identical increase value of 13.22 appear at frontend-proxy (ingress, router frontend egress), frontend (POST, executing api route /api/checkout, grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder), checkout (oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge) and payment (grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge).

For checkout's client RPC calls in the hour ending 14:34:10Z, oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge shows rpc_grpc_status_code 2 with increase 13.22 and code 0 with 79.32, while all other methods (Convert, EmptyCart, GetCart, GetProduct, GetQuote, ShipOrder) appear only with code 0.

In the comparison baseline hour ending 03:34:10Z, checkout's client calls to oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge had rpc_grpc_status_code 2 increase of 0 and code 0 increase of 97.63, with no other nonzero error code on any method.

In the final 15 minutes of the window (ending 14:34:10Z), checkout PlaceOrder spans show error increase 13.93 and non-error increase 15.00, and payment's grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge shows the same 13.93 / 15.00 split, so the error condition is present at the end of the window.

Non-checkout error spans also exist in the hour ending 14:34:10Z: ad and recommendation spans named flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream (6.10 each) and flagd's own EventStream (7.12); baseline values for these series were not queried.

Checkout's per-span breakdown for the 30 minutes ending 14:34:10Z lists oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder with STATUS_CODE_ERROR 13.45 and STATUS_CODE_UNSET 33.10, oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge with the same error value 13.45, and zero error values on oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart and oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct.

The failures most likely originate at PaymentService's Charge call (observed gRPC status code 2, UNKNOWN) and propagate upward, since Charge is the deepest operation showing errors and every enclosing layer (checkout PlaceOrder, frontend /api/checkout, frontend-proxy ingress) carries an identical error count in the last hour. No parent-child span references were retrievable, so the direction of the call edge is inferred from span naming and equal counts only, not from trace structure.

The degradation looks bursty rather than a step change: hourly PlaceOrder error increases alternate between near-zero (0, 1.02) and large values (22.37, 23.39, 12.20, 13.22) from 07:34:10Z onward, which is consistent with partial/intermittent failure of Charge rather than a full outage.

Absolute magnitudes from these increase() values are not mutually consistent across overlapping windows ending at 14:34:10Z: PlaceOrder error increase was 13.45 over 30 minutes, 13.22 over 1 hour and 13.93 over 15 minutes, so error counts and ratios derived from them should be treated as order-of-magnitude indicators, not precise rates.

Error activity in the last hour is not exclusive to the checkout path: unrelated flagd/EventStream error spans are also present on ad, flagd and recommendation, so co-occurring error activity cannot be attributed to checkout alone.

Rejected as a supported explanation: errors on the cart path. oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart carries STATUS_CODE_ERROR increase 0, and checkout's EmptyCart client calls show code 9 increase 0 in both the last hour and the baseline hour, so cart operations are not the visible error source.

gaps: No trace evidence could be obtained: the 24h traces_search for checkout exceeded the view size limit (operation 58344d87-c626-4156-8769-6fece58f6a98-t1, RESULT_TOO_LARGE), one retry hit SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE (f16681f5-9adc-416f-850d-408031ed7c78-t1) and all narrowed retries returned no_data (e.g. d615918d-a348-4b98-80f2-808fa16127bb-t0, 456518c4-deb6-4be0-9c20-b798f5ea60e1-t0, 56675cb5-86e9-4f7e-b722-b40a2f7db08a-t0, ad52da02-ee26-4a6c-9564-bb794f7b95f6-t1), so no span parent references, error messages or example failing traces are available.
Root cause of the PaymentService/Charge gRPC status 2 (UNKNOWN) responses is unknown: no error detail fields, logs, deployment/change history or payment-internal metrics were available.

Request-level checkout failure rate is unknown: traces_span_metrics_calls_total counts spans, not requests, and frontend/frontend-proxy total request counts were not queried, so the 14% (last hour) and ~48% (last 15 minutes) PlaceOrder span error shares cannot be converted to a customer-facing failure rate.
Latency behaviour on the Charge path was not assessed: no comparable baseline latency comparison was computed, so no latency trend or latency-related cause is claimed.

Two earlier metrics queries in this run timed out (operation 58344d87-c626-4156-8769-6fece58f6a98-t0 and f16681f5-9adc-416f-850d-408031ed7c78-t0), so broader per-service error series beyond those queried remain unverified.
next_steps: Retrieve example failing traces for checkout/payment (e.g. via a trace backend UI filtered on error status and the PlaceOrder/Charge operations) to confirm the call edge and capture the gRPC error message for status 2.
Inspect payment service logs and its external/downstream dependency around the onset window (from ~07:00Z on 2026-10-19) for the source of UNKNOWN Charge responses.
Review change/deployment history for payment and checkout between 06:34:10Z and 07:34:10Z, when PlaceOrder errors first became sustained.
Query frontend and frontend-proxy request counters to obtain a request-level checkout failure rate rather than a span-based share.
Confirm whether the low-volume baseline spikes at the hours ending 17:34:10Z and 18:34:10Z on 2026-10-18 (1.02 and 2.03 error spans) are normal noise or a pre-cursor.
